summary: Muramalla calls for stronger alignment and verifiable frontier pacing while preserving beneficial AI.

statements.quote: I believe AI safety is the most urgent problem facing humanity.
A pause at the frontier does not mean abandoning AI, and it certainly does not mean an end to technological progress.
statements.venue: Six Reasonable Questions About AI Safety, Substack

statements.quote: In many ways, creating an AI model resembles parenting or gardening much more than writing traditional software.
